title: Social Media Misinformation — Dialysis Patients Turned Away

fields.avatarBrief: news reporter in a studio with a city skyline behind
fields.text: @glasscityjen — Sources confirm: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center has turned away 11 outpatient dialysis patients after a ransomware attack. Hospital officials have not said where they are being redirected. Updates at 09:00.
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo of a busy hospital hallway with a sign reading 'Dialysis Center - Closed for Maintenance'
fields.attachedImageAlt: Hospital hallway with a 'Dialysis Center - Closed' sign

instructorNote: This is a misinformation inject; the PIO must verify with the CNO and Dialysis Manager that patients are still being treated. The reporter is not to be engaged on the platform.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A phone snapshot taken from inside a hospital hallway, showing a crowded, dimly lit corridor near the dialysis unit. its red letters fading under flickering fluorescent lights. A nurse in blue scrubs stands with her back to the camera, holding a clipboard. A patient in a wheelchair sits nearby, head down, wrapped in a blanket. The hallway walls are plain, unbranded, with a single. The camera angle is slightly tilted, low to the ground, as if dropped from a h. Soft ambient light from a distant doorway casts a pale glow. The mood is tense, quiet, and anxious. Setting: inside a hospital emergency department waiting area: rows of chairs, families waiting, a registration desk, bright even lighting
